Female thorax obliquity curves

Source: R/female.R
female.Rd

Thorax obliquity (upward/downward motion) curves for 71 female participants during walking, observed on a common grid of 101 points. Each column is a participant and each row is an evaluation point.

Usage

data(female)

Format

A numeric matrix with 101 rows (evaluation points) and 71 columns (participants). Column names identify participants.

Source

Van Criekinge T, Saeys W, Truijen S, Vereeck L, Sloot LH, Hallemans A. A full-body motion capture gait dataset of 138 able-bodied adults across the life span and 50 stroke survivors. Scientific Data. 2023;10:852. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-023-02767-y. The data are publicly available from the Figshare collection.
